name_zh: 保留对应多解的空间联合分支
formal_object: Each anchor vertex i has finite target modes y_i,k and model scores p_i,k>0; connected anchor graph E; no GT target coordinates.

operations.condition: Candidate support and probabilities come from the same permitted model

operations.input: Posterior-mean coordinate as a universal safe correspondence
operations.condition: Two separated valid modes are possible
operations.output: Averaging can create an unsupported interior point

operations.condition: Modes and pairwise geometry terms are declared
operations.output: Construct a discrete assignment, not a temperature change

derivation_steps.statement: For two opposite rotation modes of a vector, their mean can have a smaller norm than either mode.
derivation_steps.justification: This is a conditional mathematical counterexample, not a benchmark case or a claim of natural prevalence.

derivation_steps.statement: Choose labels k_i minimizing sum_i -log p_i,k_i + lambda sum_(i,j) ||(y_i,k_i-y_j,k_j)-R_ij(x_i-x_j)||^2.
derivation_steps.justification: A finite spatial objective rewards coherent mode choices rather than averaging across modes.

derivation_steps.statement: The general discrete objective is nonconvex; beam/message/graph search is approximate and must retain its achieved objective and budget.
derivation_steps.justification: No global optimum follows from the construction.

assumptions: Separated modes must be exposed by an actual inspected model interface; attention confidence alone is not calibrated probability.
Spatial coherence may choose the wrong symmetric part; no unique identity is guaranteed.
Rotation hints R_ij must use legal model/anchor information and identical availability for comparators.
No full dense 32768-token attention tensor is presumed feasible on this GPU.
method_expression: Extract a bounded candidate set per landmark, perform spatially coherent discrete label search, and lift selected targets with a qualified common deformation backend.
distinguishing_prediction: Benefit should concentrate on separated correspondence modes; a mean blend can improve an average score while compressing the predicted shape.
falsifier: Reject if naturally sourced modes are unimodal, or independent top-1/temperature-matched means match the same native performance at equal search cost.
closest_alternative: STAC's localized sharp blend; independent top-1; classical discrete labeling. Historical m03 also selects candidates over time, so spatial joint mode preservation needs explicit collision review.
decisive_comparison: Common native inputs, candidates and deformation backend: sharp mean, independent top-1 and spatial joint labels; full official CD-M/3D/4D and matched search budget.
operational_delta: Changes posterior reduction and joint spatial decision, not just top-k or temperature; functional originality is unresolved.
feasibility_and_cost: Sparse/chunked attention capture and bounded landmark search are required. Interfaces, lifting baseline and full-mesh memory remain unqualified.
structural_signature: Discrete spatial mode assignment before deformation, as opposed to continuous averaging or mass balancing.
algebra_review_basis: Variance identity and collapse counterexample rechecked. No promise of correct correspondence or a polynomial global solver.
empirical_status: Not implemented in this round; no native method comparison or outcome.
originality_status: Unadjudicated. Classical tools and historical related code are explicitly attributed.
